claims.claim: Mars Climate Orbiter launched on December 11, 1998 and last contact was received on September 23, 1999, about nine months later.
Ground software used English units while another part of the system expected metric units, causing trajectory calculation errors.
The trajectory sent the spacecraft too close to Mars and the investigation concluded it likely burned up in the atmosphere.
The investigation identified systems-engineering and communication/process deficiencies in addition to the unit mismatch.
